# Gallery assets

Add future studio or client-work photos to this folder as optimized `.webp` or `.jpg` files.

- Use lowercase, descriptive filenames such as `double-helix-silver.webp`.
- Aim for images under 500 KB when possible.
- Add each new image to `galleryItems` in `src/data/studioContent.js`.
- Include useful alternative text and obtain permission before publishing identifiable client photos.
